pages.text: Welcome to RIFT//STAR. Make a basic shelter, gather food, and bring a crafting table. Then pick ONE adventure. None of these four paths must be completed first; the world is yours to explore.

For an early trip, find bees for the Bumblezone or hunt for a Gatekeeper house for Blue Skies. For a longer expedition, search for an Underground Cabin and a Cave Tablet. To reach other planets, follow the Ad Astra machine and rocket recipes in JEI.

Use JEI (the item list beside your inventory) to see crafting ingredients, including cross-mod alternatives. The advancement tab tracks optional discoveries. Return to this book whenever you want a new direction.
